name: Tea at the Manor (Trang Trà Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: once per foe each fight, when the foe carries eight or more of your Wood Poison stacks, they drink the second cup: they are Charmed, their Wood Poison batches refresh, and they gain 2 Heavy Breath.

story: The robe and the pot are the mistress's own, made for the gracious door. She wears them beside Phi Hồng, which is half of another pair, Lạc Anh's twin swords. That pair waits on Tàn Hồng and is not part of this set.

name: The Back Garden (Hậu Viên Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: once your Wood Poison has lasted 6 s on a foe, your Wood Poison grants double-stack (+1 stack per grant). Once a fight when a Wood art (other than Gather More) lands on a foe with 6+ Wood stacks after 6 s of poison, you harvest all Wood stacks for immediate Chaos damage and heal 0.5 % max health per stack.

story: The gourd over Hàn Tư Quân's grave, the trellis pins and the ring of her father's tree. She made the set herself in the garden, and none of it has ever been through the front door.
